task_title: Implement Sovereign Cap Spore Bloom runtime slice

plan_review.notes: Adversarial review by copilot-pull-request-reviewer on PR #2012. Compared (A) multi-circle committed geometry (chosen) vs (B) reusing main's spawn-circles geometry type — reviewer correctly identified the naming collision and that spawn-circles geometry was being added separately on main; (C) zone-tick-after-resolve (initial) vs zone-tick-before-resolve (correct) — reviewer found the off-by-one-frame bug; (D) Verdigris/bronze burst renderer for all abilities vs per-ability dispatched burst renderers — reviewer required Sovereign-specific fungal/spore burst. Resolved: types.ts now carries both spawn-circles and multi-circle; ticking order moved before resolve; spawnSporeBurst added with COLOR_SPORE_RIM/SPORE_FOG/SPORE_PUFF colors; PR link and E2E visual assertions also addressed.
